variants.title: Step-up transformer: turns ratio and efficiency
variants.sample: Generic demonstration transformer connected as step-up
variants.aim: Find the turns ratio of a small step-up transformer from its open-circuit voltages, then load it and find its efficiency from the input power and the output power.
